title: Automated Smoke Testing for Multi-ending Game Quests via Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern game quests are increasingly trending toward high freedom and multiple endings, making their design and testing more complex. Smoke testing in games aims to rapidly validate quest functionality, but existing automated testing approaches face critical limitations when handling quests with branching narratives, and multiple possible endings. These challenges result in insufficient exploration of endings, redundant action sequences, and prohibitively high interaction costs. To address these challenges, we propose EndWeaver, an automated smoke testing framework specifically designed for multi-ending game tasks. EndWeaver leverages LLMs to interpret quest descriptions and game environments, generating high-level methods to guide global exploration, complemented by the generated primitive task sequences for fine-grained planning. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的多结局游戏任务自动化冒烟测试
translated_abstract: 现代游戏任务日益趋向高自由度和多结局，使其设计和测试变得更加复杂。游戏中的冒烟测试旨在快速验证任务功能，但现有的自动化测试方法在处理具有分支叙事和多种可能结局的任务时面临关键局限。这些挑战导致对结局的探索不足、冗余的动作序列，以及过高的交互成本。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了EndWeaver，一个专门为多结局游戏任务设计的自动化冒烟测试框架。EndWeaver利用大语言模型来解读任务描述和游戏环境，生成高层方法以指导全局探索，并通过生成的原语任务序列进行细粒度规划。通过将这种多层次规划结构与状态转换图的动态构建相结合，EndWeaver能够……
tldr: 提出了EndWeaver，一个专门面向多结局游戏任务的自动化冒烟测试框架，利用大语言模型进行多层次规划并结合状态转换图的动态构建，实现对分支叙事的高效探索和结局的快速验证。
en_tdlr: EndWeaver, an automated smoke testing framework for multi-ending game quests that leverages LLM-based multi-level planning combined with dynamic state-transition graph construction to efficiently explore branching narratives and validate quest endings.
